non_CM_corollary: j = 8192/11 has denominator 11, so j is not an algebraic integer; a CM elliptic curve has integral j-invariant, hence E_sigma has no complex multiplication.
routeA_formula: j = 27 t (t+8)^3 / (t-1)^3 with t = mu^3 = -d^3/(27abc) for the Hesse form a x^3 + b y^3 + c z^3 + d xyz
routeB_formula: j = 6912 I^3 / (4I^3 - J^2), I,J the invariants of the binary quartic Q2^2 - 4 L C3 (branch divisor of the projection of the plane cubic from a point on it)
